uz.name: Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internati
uz.about: Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internati aniq fanlar yo'nalishidagi fanlarni chuqurlashtirib o'qitadi.
uz.life: Maktabimiz al-Xorazmiy, Abu Rayhon Beruniy kabi buyuk ajdodlarimizning munosib davomchilarini tarbiyalash va aniq fanlar bo'yicha iqtidorli o'quvchilarni aniqlashni maqsad qilgan.
perks: Uzoq hududlardan kelgan o'quvchilar uchun bepul zamonaviy yotoqxona
Kuniga 5 mahal bepul ovqatlanish (yotoqxonada yashovchi o'quvchilar uchun)
Bir nechta to'garaklarga bepul qatnashish
Turli sport tadbirlarida ishtirok etish
Maktab formasi beriladi (xarajatning bir qismini ota-onalar to'laydi)
Matematika, fizika, ingliz tili, tarix, biologiya va kimyo fanlari chuqurlashtirib o'qitiladi
Yuqori tezlikdagi optik internet
Darsliklar bilan ta'minlanadi
SAT va IELTS imtihonlariga ixtisoslashgan o'qituvchilar tayyorlaydi
Zamonaviy, keng kutubxona
Zamonaviy bilimga ega yuqori malakali o'qituvchilar
O'qishda yuqori natijalarga erishgan va xalqaro sertifikatga ega o'quvchilar O'zbekiston va xorijdagi oliy ta'lim muassasalariga muddatidan oldin kirish imkoniga ega
Hozirgacha barcha bitiruvchilarimiz talabalik baxtiga muyassar bo'lgan

admission.grades: 5-sinf — aniq fanlar yo'nalishi; 7-sinf — tabiiy fanlar yo'nalishi

docs: Ota-onaning (vasiyning) pasport ma'lumotlari va doimiy ishlaydigan telefon raqamlari

about_items.title: Aniq fanlarga ixtisoslashgan maktab
about_items.text: Prezident ta'lim muassasalari agentligi tizimidagi Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internati O'zbekiston Respublikasi Prezidentining 2022-yil 14-apreldagi PF-106-son “Prezident ta'lim muassasalari agentligi tizimidagi ixtisoslashtirilgan maktablar tarmog'ini kengaytirish to'g'risida”gi Farmoniga muvofiq tashkil etilgan. Maktab aniq fanlarni chuqurlashtirib o'qitishga ixtisoslashgan.

about_items.title: Maktab hayoti
about_items.text: Maktabimiz al-Xorazmiy, Abu Rayhon Beruniy kabi buyuk ajdodlarimizning munosib davomchilarini tarbiyalash va aniq fanlar bo'yicha iqtidorli o'quvchilarni aniqlashni maqsad qilgan.

about_items.title: Malakali o'qituvchilar
about_items.text: O'qituvchilarimiz xalqaro sertifikatlarni olib, bilimlarini oshiradi va bu tajribani o'quvchilarimizga yetkazadi.

en.name: Karshi City Specialized Boarding School No. 1
en.agency: Part of the Agency of Specialized Educational Institutions
en.tagline: A boarding school specializing in the exact sciences
en.about: Karshi City Specialized Boarding School No. 1 offers advanced teaching in the exact sciences.
en.life: Our school aims to raise worthy successors to great scholars such as al-Khwarizmi and Abu Rayhan Biruni, and to discover talented students in the exact sciences.
perks: Free modern dormitory for students from distant areas
Five free meals a day (for dormitory students)
Free access to several clubs
Various sports activities
School uniform provided (parents cover part of the cost)
In-depth study of mathematics, physics, English, history, biology and chemistry
High-speed fiber-optic internet
Textbooks provided
Specialist teachers prepare students for the SAT and IELTS
A modern, spacious library
Highly qualified teachers with modern expertise
Students with outstanding results and international certificates can gain early admission to universities in Uzbekistan and abroad
To date, every one of our graduates has been admitted to university

admission.grades: Grade 5 — exact sciences; grade 7 — natural sciences
admission.period: Usually from June 10 to June 30, online at ariza.piima.uz
docs: Parent's or guardian's passport details and working phone numbers

about_items.title: Specialized in the exact sciences
about_items.text: Karshi City Specialized Boarding School No. 1, part of the Agency of Presidential Educational Institutions, was established under Decree No. PF-106 of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan of April 14, 2022, “On expanding the network of specialized schools within the Agency of Presidential Educational Institutions”. The school specializes in in-depth teaching of the exact sciences.

about_items.title: School life
about_items.text: Our school aims to raise worthy successors to great scholars such as al-Khwarizmi and Abu Rayhan Biruni, and to discover talented students in the exact sciences.

about_items.title: Qualified teachers
about_items.text: Our teachers keep improving their skills by earning international certificates, and they pass this expertise on to our students.
